absorbance.def: A unitless measure of how much light of one wavelength a sample absorbs; 0 means none. Transmittance is the fraction of light that passes through.

beer-lambert.def: A = εbc: absorbance equals the molar absorptivity ε (L/(mol·cm)) times the path length b (cm) times the concentration c (mol/L).

spectrophotometer.def: An instrument that passes light of a chosen wavelength through a sample in a cuvette and measures its absorbance. Measurements are made at λmax, and a calibration curve of standards gives an unknown's concentration.
